sn46.37:1.1: Pañcime bhikkhave āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā cetaso uppakkilesā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā ||
sn46.37:1.3: Kāmacchando bhikkhave āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso upakkileso paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo ||
sn46.37:1.4: Byāpādo bhikkhave āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso uppakkileso paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo || ||
sn46.37:1.5: Thīnamiddham bhikkhave āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ cetaso upakkilesam paññāya dubbalīkaraṇaṃ ||
sn46.37:1.6: Uddhaccakukkuccam bhikkhave āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ cetaso upakkilesam paññāya dubbalīkaraṇaṃ || ||
sn46.37:1.7: Vicikicchā bhikkhave āvaranā nīvaraṇā cetaso uppakkilesā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā || || 4.
sn46.37:1.8: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca āvaranā nīvaraṇā cetaso upakkilesā paññāya dubbulīkaraṇā || || 5.
sn46.37:2.1: Sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anuppakkilesā bhavitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti || ||
sn46.37:2.3: Satisambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anupakkileso bhāvito bahulīkato vijjavimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati || la-pe || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anuppakkileso bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati || || 7.
sn46.37:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇa cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti || || 8.
